instructions: Review the threads under `## Review threads to resolve` before running mutations.
Use the generated commands as shown. Human-authored IDs use `--reply-thread-ids`. Bot and non-human IDs use `--resolve-thread-ids`. Shepherd does not resolve human-authored threads.
For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to `## Shepherd Journal` with `pr-shepherd apply journal 42 '- <decision>'`.
Link threads and comments from their headings. Cite reviews by ID.
Before `apply review:`, remove any `--reply-thread-ids` entry whose latest visible comment is your own Shepherd reply. Do not reply to yourself.
Replace `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` with one sentence describing what changed.
Run the `apply review:` command shown above.

`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. After completing these steps, continue with the next poll: run the default `pr-shepherd` command again, or call MCP `iterate` again. Stop only on `[CANCEL]`, `[ESCALATE]`, or human direction.
